OBSERVATION / THE SIGNAL

Read the results honestly.

Correct means the returned value matches the reference answer. Unknown means the model declined to guess. Mismatch means it returned a different value—review the individual answers.

MARGIN NOTES / THE LIMITS

What this proves—and what it doesn't.

Each run shows performance on 20 synthetic facts, using the same model and temperature. It is not a measurement of memory capacity, and one run is not a reliable accuracy estimate. Missing recall after withholding facts is expected; it is not automatically hallucination.
